procurement_key_commitments: Annual payment upfront in exchange for 10–12% discount on list price
EU data residency (Frankfurt) guaranteed in MSA for Zoho and HubSpot
Named CSM and SLA of 99.9% uptime in contract
Data export right within 30 days of termination — already confirmed for Zoho (comp_zoho_export_clause: true)
Auto-renewal opt-out notice period: 90 days before anniversary
procurement_negotiation_leverage: 40-seat deal is at lower threshold for enterprise discounting — bundle with 3-year term to push Zoho seat rate below €30
Competing bid from HubSpot documented at €24,000/yr gives walk-away anchor
October peak deadline creates urgency but can be used to extract accelerated onboarding credits
EU public-sector analogues in logistics have achieved 15–20% off Zoho list; cite peer benchmarks
Request NetSuite connector support (integration gap) as a concession rather than paying separately

procurement_risks.risk: Vendor lock-in if multi-year term signed without break clause
procurement_risks.mitigation: Negotiate annual break option after year 1 with 90-day notice; verify against comp_zoho_export_clause already true

procurement_risks.risk: Price escalation clause (CPI or fixed %) could inflate cost beyond fin_zoho_3yr: 54720 baseline
procurement_risks.mitigation: Cap annual price increase at 5% in contract; lock seat price for first 3 years

procurement_risks.risk: Procurement timeline slippage risks missing rollout_phase1_date: 2026-07-01
procurement_risks.mitigation: Begin RFP and legal review immediately; allocate 4 weeks lead time; assign dedicated procurement owner

procurement_risks.risk: GDPR subprocessor changes (notice period 30 days) may be insufficient for legal review
procurement_risks.mitigation: Negotiate subprocessor notice to 60 days in DPA addendum; both vendors have DPA confirmed (gdpr_dpa_both: true)

procurement_risks.risk: NetSuite connector gap for Zoho may require third-party vendor contract adding cost and liability
procurement_risks.mitigation: Request Zoho to bundle connector support or confirm certified partner pricing; add liability pass-through clause
